claim: AMD's revenue topped $6.0 billion in the third quarter of 2024.
summary: AMD reported Q3 2024 (July-September 2024) revenue of approximately $6.82 billion, which exceeds the $6.0 billion threshold, so the claim that revenue topped $6.0 billion is supported by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: AMD's revenue in Q3 2024 was greater than $6.0 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: AMD's revenue topped $6.0 billion in the third quarter of 2024
sub_claims.note: Based on knowledge cutoff, AMD's Q3 2024 earnings release reported revenue of ~$6.82 billion, exceeding $6.0 billion.
